## Mục con

- [camera](camera/INDEX.md) — A camera converts the mobjects contained in a Scene into an array of pixels.
- [mapping_camera](mapping_camera/INDEX.md) — A camera module that supports spatial mapping between objects for distortion effects.
- [moving_camera](moving_camera/INDEX.md) — Defines the MovingCamera class, a camera that can pan and zoom through a scene.
- [multi_camera](multi_camera/INDEX.md) — A camera supporting multiple perspectives.
- [three_d_camera](three_d_camera/INDEX.md) — A camera that can be positioned and oriented in three-dimensional space.
